question: Should this PR remove tag-only Lambda cleanup authority in favor of exact local-claim authority, despite requiring manual cleanup or recovery when local claims are missing?
rationale: The security issue is source-reproducible and the patch follows the recommended boundary, but the change intentionally fails closed for existing tag-only cleanup and the live proof gate is waived in the PR body rather than demonstrated.

options.title: Accept claim-bound cleanup
options.body: Merge after exact-head CI/security review, accepting that tag-only cleanup becomes manual or recovery-only to close the destructive ownership boundary.

options.title: Require live Lambda proof first
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted live create/list/stop/cleanup output or a maintainer-applied proof override confirms the real provider lifecycle.

options.title: Add recovery UX before merge
options.body: Keep fail-closed semantics but first add a clearer import, doctor, or manual-recovery path for lost-claim Lambda resources.

recommendation.title: Accept claim-bound cleanup
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head CI/security review, accepting that tag-only cleanup becomes manual or recovery-only to close the destructive ownership boundary.
